title: Named Tunnel Anthem (Pin It Down)
style: anthemic synth-rock, 118 bpm, 336 hz subharmonic, hopeful chord stack, gang-vocal chorus, sysadmin pride energy, soaring lead
lyrics:
[Intro]
got the token, got the route
time to write the config out

[Verse 1]
stop the random three-word lottery
stop the dying tunnel mockery
grab a name and pin it down
put your demo on a permanent town

[Pre-Chorus]
cname pointing at the cloud
uptime ninety-nine point loud

[Chorus]
named tunnel anthem, pin it down
domain you control on a permanent town
laptop closes, link still alive
that's how a real demo survives

[Verse 2]
cloudflare zero trust on the gate
workers route serving up the plate
pages free tier carries the load
you are now on the real road

[Chorus]
named tunnel anthem, pin it down
domain you control on a permanent town
laptop closes, link still alive
that's how a real demo survives

[Bridge]
share a link that lives past lunch
share a link with a real punch

[Outro]
pin it down, pin it down
permanent town, permanent town
